records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Revenue: For the nine months ended October 31, 2021, revenue was $19.2 billion, an increase of 24 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in subscription and support revenues for the three and nine months ended October 31, 2021 was primarily caused by volume-driven increases from new business, which includes new customers, upgrades, additional subscriptions from existing customers and acquisition activity.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Remaining Performance Obligation: Remaining performance obligation as of October 31, 2021 was approximately $36.3 billion, which includes approximately $900 million of remaining performance obligation related to the Slack acquisition, an increase of 20 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result of our aggressive growth plans and integration of our previously acquired businesses, we have incurred significant expenses for equity awards and amortization of purchased intangibles, which have reduced our operating income.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Cash: Cash provided by operations for the nine months ended October 31, 2021 was $4.0 billion, an increase of 53 percent year-over-year.
